summary_1line: Garuda befriends Indra, enables the recovery of the Amrita, tricks the snakes, and their tongues split while Sauti begins listing the chief serpents.

image_candidates.scene_text: Garuda declares to Indra that he could bear the entire Earth and all worlds upon a single feather.
The snakes eagerly lick the kusa grass where the Amrita had rested, their tongues splitting into two.
Indra swiftly seizes the pot of Amrita from the kusa grass while the snakes are away performing their ablutions.
